quests.question: A police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe, while a security guard watches over one place, like a store.
quests.hint: A police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe, while a security guard watches over one place, like a store.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a police officer. Police officers keep neighborhoods safe and help people follow the rules.
quests.funFact: Police officers help keep the whole neighborhood safe.
quests.wordExample: The police officer helped us cross the busy street.

quests.question: A pilot flies the airplane, while a flight attendant helps passengers stay safe and comfortable.
quests.hint: A pilot flies the airplane, while a flight attendant helps passengers stay safe and comfortable.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a pilot. Pilots fly airplanes and take passengers to faraway places.
quests.funFact: Some pilots fly people all around the world in one week!
quests.wordExample: The pilot welcomed everyone aboard before takeoff.

quests.question: An astronaut travels into outer space, while a pilot flies airplanes here on Earth.
quests.hint: An astronaut travels into outer space, while a pilot flies airplanes here on Earth.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is an astronaut. Astronauts travel into space to explore and learn.
quests.funFact: Astronauts train underwater on Earth to get ready for floating in space.
quests.wordExample: The astronaut waved from the window of the space station.

quests.question: A police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe, while a security guard watches over one place, like a store.
quests.hint: A police officer keeps a whole neighborhood safe, while a security guard watches over one place, like a store.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a police officer. Police officers keep neighborhoods safe and help people follow the rules.
quests.funFact: Some police officers ride bicycles or horses while they work!
quests.wordExample: A police officer waved to the children walking to school.

quests.question: A pilot flies the airplane, while a flight attendant helps passengers stay safe and comfortable.
quests.hint: A pilot flies the airplane, while a flight attendant helps passengers stay safe and comfortable.
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a pilot. Pilots fly airplanes and take passengers to faraway places.
quests.funFact: Pilots learn to read many dials and screens before they can fly.
quests.wordExample: The pilot flew the airplane smoothly through the clouds.

quests.question: A photographer takes pictures with a camera, while an artist paints or draws pictures by hand.
quests.hint: A photographer takes pictures with a camera, while an artist paints or draws pictures by hand.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a photographer. Photographers use a camera to capture special moments.
quests.funFact: A photographer might take hundreds of pictures to find the perfect one!
quests.wordExample: The photographer took our picture in front of the fountain.

quests.question: A mason builds with brick and stone, while a carpenter builds and fixes things made of wood.
quests.hint: A mason builds with brick and stone, while a carpenter builds and fixes things made of wood.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a mason. Masons build walls and structures using brick or stone.
quests.funFact: A mason lines up each brick so carefully that walls stay strong for years!
quests.wordExample: The mason stacked bricks to build a garden wall.

quests.question: A baker mainly makes bread and cakes, while a chef cooks many different kinds of meals.
quests.hint: A baker mainly makes bread and cakes, while a chef cooks many different kinds of meals.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a baker. Bakers bake fresh bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.funFact: Bakers often start work before sunrise so bread is fresh for breakfast.
quests.wordExample: The baker took warm bread out of the oven.

quests.question: An archaeologist digs up and studies objects from ancient human history, while a paleontologist studies fossils from animals that lived millions of years ago.
quests.hint: An archaeologist digs up and studies objects from ancient human history, while a paleontologist studies fossils from animals that lived millions of years ago.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an archaeologist. Archaeologists dig up and study objects from ancient times.
quests.funFact: Archaeologists study old ruins to learn how people lived long ago.
quests.wordExample: The archaeologist studied the ancient ruins.

quests.question: A mason builds with brick and stone, while a carpenter builds and fixes things made of wood.
quests.hint: A mason builds with brick and stone, while a carpenter builds and fixes things made of wood.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a mason. Masons build walls and structures using brick or stone.
quests.funFact: Masons use a tool called a trowel to spread cement between bricks.
quests.wordExample: The mason spread cement between each brick.

quests.question: A baker mainly makes bread and cakes, while a chef cooks many different kinds of meals.
quests.hint: A baker mainly makes bread and cakes, while a chef cooks many different kinds of meals.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a baker. Bakers bake fresh bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.funFact: A baker can turn simple flour and water into warm, fresh bread!
quests.wordExample: The baker decorated the birthday cake with icing.

quests.question: A doctor treats sick people, while a vet takes care of sick animals.
quests.hint: A doctor treats sick people, while a vet takes care of sick animals.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a doctor. Doctors help people stay healthy and get better when they are sick.
quests.funFact: Many doctors use a tool called a stethoscope to listen to your heart.
quests.wordExample: My doctor gave me a sticker after my check-up.

quests.question: An engineer designs how something works, like a machine or bridge, while an architect designs how a building looks and is arranged.
quests.hint: An engineer designs how something works, like a machine or bridge, while an architect designs how a building looks and is arranged.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an engineer. Engineers design and build machines, roads, and other useful things.
quests.funFact: Engineers use math and science together to solve everyday problems.
quests.wordExample: The engineer designed a stronger bridge for the town.

quests.question: A carpenter builds things from wood, while a construction worker builds whole buildings from many materials.
quests.hint: A carpenter builds things from wood, while a construction worker builds whole buildings from many materials.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a carpenter. Carpenters build and fix things made of wood, like tables and doors.
quests.funFact: Carpenters measure wood very carefully before they ever cut it.
quests.wordExample: The carpenter measured the wood before cutting it.

quests.question: A fisherman catches fish from the water, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals on land.
quests.hint: A fisherman catches fish from the water, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals on land.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a fisherman. Fishermen catch fish from the sea, rivers, or lakes.
quests.funFact: Some fishermen wake up before sunrise to catch fish while the sea is calm.
quests.wordExample: The fisherman cast his line into the calm lake.

quests.question: An engineer designs how something works, like a machine or bridge, while an architect designs how a building looks and is arranged.
quests.hint: An engineer designs how something works, like a machine or bridge, while an architect designs how a building looks and is arranged.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is an engineer. Engineers design and build machines, roads, and other useful things.
quests.funFact: There are many kinds of engineers, from building bridges to designing toys!
quests.wordExample: The engineer tested the new machine before it was built.

quests.question: An artist paints or draws pictures, while a photographer takes pictures using a camera.
quests.hint: An artist paints or draws pictures, while a photographer takes pictures using a camera.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is an artist. Artists paint and draw pictures full of color and imagination.
quests.funFact: Artists mix colors together to create thousands of new shades!
quests.wordExample: The artist painted a colorful picture of the sunset.

quests.question: A surgeon is a doctor who performs operations, while a regular doctor mostly checks and treats illness without operating.
quests.hint: A surgeon is a doctor who performs operations, while a regular doctor mostly checks and treats illness without operating.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a surgeon. Surgeons are doctors who perform operations to fix problems inside the body.
quests.funFact: A surgeon trains for many extra years after becoming a doctor.
quests.wordExample: The surgeon washed her hands before the operation began.

quests.question: A lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court, while a judge listens to both sides and decides what is fair.
quests.hint: A lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court, while a judge listens to both sides and decides what is fair.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: A lawyer reads carefully through many papers before every case.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer helped explain the contract to her client.

quests.question: A farmer grows crops and raises animals on land, while a fisherman catches fish from the water.
quests.hint: A farmer grows crops and raises animals on land, while a fisherman catches fish from the water.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a farmer. Farmers grow the crops and raise the animals that give us food.
quests.funFact: Some farmers wake up before the sun rises to start their work.
quests.wordExample: The farmer fed the chickens early in the morning.

quests.question: A gardener takes care of flowers and plants in a yard or park, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals on a big piece of land.
quests.hint: A gardener takes care of flowers and plants in a yard or park, while a farmer grows crops and raises animals on a big piece of land.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a gardener. Gardeners plant and take care of flowers, plants, and trees.
quests.funFact: Gardeners know exactly how much water and sun each plant needs.
quests.wordExample: The gardener planted new seeds in the garden.

quests.question: A lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court, while a judge listens to both sides and decides what is fair.
quests.hint: A lawyer helps and speaks for one person in court, while a judge listens to both sides and decides what is fair.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a lawyer. Lawyers help and speak for people who need help with the law.
quests.funFact: Lawyers study for many years to learn all about the law.
quests.wordExample: The lawyer spoke carefully on behalf of her client in court.

quests.question: A chef cooks many different meals, while a baker mainly makes bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.hint: A chef cooks many different meals, while a baker mainly makes bread, cakes, and pastries.
quests.explanation: Correct! This is a chef. Chefs cook tasty meals in restaurants.
quests.funFact: Some chefs train for years to learn how to cook hundreds of dishes.
quests.wordExample: The chef added fresh herbs to the soup.

quests.question: A dentist takes care of your teeth, while a doctor takes care of your whole body.
quests.hint: A dentist takes care of your teeth, while a doctor takes care of your whole body.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a dentist. Dentists check and clean teeth to keep your smile healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say brushing twice a day helps keep your teeth strong.
quests.wordExample: The dentist checked my teeth and said they looked great.

quests.question: A construction worker builds a building, while an architect draws the plans for it first.
quests.hint: A construction worker builds a building, while an architect draws the plans for it first.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a construction worker. Construction workers build houses, roads, and tall buildings.
quests.funFact: It can take hundreds of construction workers to build one tall building!
quests.wordExample: The construction workers built a new school near our house.

quests.question: A marine biologist studies wild animals in the ocean, while a vet takes care of sick pets and farm animals.
quests.hint: A marine biologist studies wild animals in the ocean, while a vet takes care of sick pets and farm animals.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a marine biologist. Marine biologists study the plants and animals that live in the ocean.
quests.funFact: A marine biologist might study a single kind of fish for years!
quests.wordExample: The marine biologist studied a school of colorful fish.

quests.question: A house painter paints the walls of a home, while an artist paints pictures full of color and imagination.
quests.hint: A house painter paints the walls of a home, while an artist paints pictures full of color and imagination.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a house painter. House painters paint the walls of homes and buildings.
quests.funFact: A house painter can turn a dull room into a bright one in one afternoon!
quests.wordExample: The house painter rolled fresh paint onto the wall.

quests.question: A construction worker builds a building, while an architect draws the plans for it first.
quests.hint: A construction worker builds a building, while an architect draws the plans for it first.
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a construction worker. Construction workers build houses, roads, and tall buildings.
quests.funFact: Construction workers always wear a hard hat to keep their head safe.
quests.wordExample: The construction worker wore a bright orange vest and a hard hat.

quests.question: An astronomer studies space from Earth using a telescope, while an astronaut actually travels into space.
quests.hint: An astronomer studies space from Earth using a telescope, while an astronaut actually travels into space.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an astronomer. Astronomers study stars, planets, and space using powerful telescopes.
quests.funFact: Astronomers often work at night, when the sky is darkest.
quests.wordExample: The astronomer studied pictures of a distant planet.

quests.question: An electrician fixes wires and electricity, while a plumber fixes pipes and water.
quests.hint: An electrician fixes wires and electricity, while a plumber fixes pipes and water.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an electrician. Electricians install and repair the wires that bring us electricity.
quests.funFact: An electrician must learn exactly how electricity moves through wires.
quests.wordExample: The electrician checked all the wires behind the wall.
